system.description: Allied creatures of your choice are unaffected by your Solid Fog’s harmful effects. Additionally, willing allied creatures within a Solid Fog, that has a Physical condition can spend their bonus action(s) to inhale some of the fog. When they do, they can select one of the physical conditions they have and remove all ranks of it. A creature can only remove conditions in this way once, every 10 minutes.
